function.arguments: {"finding": "Arm assignment is strongly confounded with baseline severity: treatment arm has more severe patients (95 severe vs 21 control), while control has more mild patients (332 vs 58). This is consistent with clinical practice where sicker patients are more likely to receive treatment. A raw difference in response rates between arms would be confounded by this imbalance, potentially reversing the true treatment effect.", "implication": "We cannot report the raw difference in response rates as a causal treatment effect. But we must note the confounding in the report."}
function.name: note_finding
